name: The Amethyst Mines
about: Galleries of violet crystal around an underground lake, the wild area of Anvildeep: neon-tipped amethyst clusters throwing violet light, drifting cave orbs, a stone jetty, the slag pits with their ember cracks, mine carts, and a hidden crystal hollow. The chain-lift back up to Copper Row is at the south-west.
